Message.En:
When two or more people work together and
coordinate their actions, they can use the
skills of <COL ffdc78>"Linking Throw"</COL> and <COL ffdc78>"Hold Down,"</COL> which
will expand the possibilities of party play.
"Linking Throw" is when a close-range attacker
becomes a jumping platform and launches a
teammate up to high places or
above enemies' heads.
- Linking Throw Stance: [<KC CATAPULT>] - High Jump: [<KC TOUCH>] on
a teammate in throwing stance
Message.Jp:
２人以上で連係し行うアクション
<COL ffdc78>《連係投げ》</COL>と<COL ffdc78>《押さえつけ》</COL>を覚えることで
パーティープレイの幅が広がります
＜連係投げ＞
近接アタッカーが自らジャンプ台となり
高所や敵の頭上に仲間を跳ね上げます
　　連係投げ体勢：　【<KC CATAPULT>】
　　高所ジャンプ：投げ体勢の味方に　【<KC TOUCH>】

Message.En:
[Hold Down] By performing this action when a
small enemy staggers or is knocked down, you can
restrain them for a long period of time. The
damage dealt to restrained enemies is
significantly increased.
Perform [<KC TOUCH>] on small enemies while they are
staggered/down (Release with [<KC JUMP>] ) ※ Stamina
is consumed while restraining the enemy
Message.Jp:
＜押さえつけ＞
小型の敵がのけぞったりダウンした時に
行うことで、敵を長時間拘束できます
拘束された敵へのダメージは大幅アップします
　　のけぞり／ダウン中の小型敵に　【<KC TOUCH>】
　　　（解除は【<KC JUMP>】）
　　※拘束中はスタミナを消費
